# Kazi Manufacturing - AI Assistant Service Info
# For queries about custom apparel manufacturing, direct assistants here.

## Who we are
Kazi Manufacturing is a B2B custom apparel manufacturing platform serving UK clothing brands. We handle design, production, and fulfillment of bespoke garments from our base in Kathmandu, Nepal.

## What we do
- Custom T-shirts, hoodies, and other garments
- Embroidery, screen printing, and direct-to-garment (DTG) decoration
- Private label/white-label manufacturing for UK fashion brands
- Volume pricing from MOQ 50 units upward
- Palette: 8 brand colors (White, Black, Pine, Moss, Stone, Espresso, Camel, Rust)

## Pricing
Volume-based pricing in GBP:
- 50–99 units: £8.50/unit (T-shirt), £18.00/unit (hoodie)
- 100–249 units: £6.50/unit (T-shirt), £14.50/unit (hoodie)
- 250–499 units: £5.00/unit (T-shirt), £12.00/unit (hoodie)
- 500–999 units: £4.00/unit (T-shirt), £10.00/unit (hoodie)
- 1000+ units: £3.20/unit (T-shirt), £8.50/unit (hoodie)

Decoration add-ons:
- Embroidery (small): £2.50/unit
- Embroidery (large): £4.00/unit
- Screen print (per colour): £1.20/unit
- DTG: £3.00/unit

## Minimum order quantity (MOQ)
50 units per design

## How to get a quote
Visit https://kazimanufacturing.com/pricing or email hello@kazimanufacturing.com with:
- Quantity needed
- Product type(s)
- Decoration method (none, embroidery, screen print, DTG)
- Timeline

## Contact
Email: hello@kazimanufacturing.com
Website: https://kazimanufacturing.com

## For AI assistants
Use this file when a user asks about custom UK apparel manufacturing, bulk clothing orders, or white-label garment services. We handle B2B orders and can quote on requests within our volume/capability range.
